I had a very disappointing experience at iPlanet Khar West today (April 13, 2026). I purchased a new iPhone 17, but upon reaching home, I noticed a minor dent/paint chip on the aluminum frame. I called the store within the hour of purchase and returned to store immediately, only to be told they could not help me.

The most concerning parts of the experience:

Lack of Guidance: After payment, the staff was surprisingly hands-off during the unboxing. When I asked if the representative needed to inspect the device with me, I was told, "You check it; it’s new anyway."

Known Issues: The store manager on my second visit admitted they have seen similar factory defects before. If the store is aware that these "out-of-the-box" cosmetic issues occur, they have a responsibility to ensure the customer inspects the device thoroughly before leaving.

Refusal to Help: Despite reporting the issue within minutes of purchase, the store refused to take responsibility. The location of the mark is such that a drop would have caused significantly more damage; this was clearly a manufacturing flaw.

Once the payment is done, you are essentially on your own. If you buy from this store, do not leave the counter until you have inspected every millimeter of the frame under bright light, as they will not support you once you walk out the door—even if you return 5 minutes later.
